question_text.en: Which of the following is known as artificial silk?
question_text.hi: निम्नलिखित में से किसे कृत्रिम रेशम (artificial silk) कहा जाता है?

explanation: Rayon is obtained by chemical treatment of wood pulp, which makes it similar to silk but artificial.
distractor_rationale: Nylon is fully synthetic and not called artificial silk. Polyester is used for wrinkle-free clothes. Acrylic is artificial wool, not silk.

ai_context.learning_goal: Identify Rayon as artificial silk and its origin from wood pulp.
common_misconceptions: All synthetic fibres are completely made of petrochemicals (Rayon uses wood pulp).
ai_context.hint: Think of the fibre made from wood pulp that looks shiny like silk.

question_text.en: Why is Nylon used for making parachutes and rock climbing ropes?
question_text.hi: नायलॉन (Nylon) का उपयोग पैराशूट और रॉक क्लाइम्बिंग की रस्सियाँ बनाने के लिए क्यों किया जाता है?

en: It is very light and weak.
It is stronger than a steel wire of the same thickness.
hi: यह बहुत हल्का और कमजोर होता है।
यह एक प्राकृतिक रेशा (natural fibre) है।
यह समान मोटाई वाले स्टील के तार से अधिक मजबूत होता है।
यह आसानी से पानी सोख लेता है।

answer: It is stronger than a steel wire of the same thickness.
explanation: Nylon thread is actually stronger than a steel wire, making it highly suitable for heavy-duty applications like parachutes and rock climbing.
distractor_rationale: Nylon is strong, not weak. It is a synthetic fibre, not natural. It does not easily absorb water, which is why it dries quickly.

ai_context.learning_goal: Understand the exceptional tensile strength of Nylon.
common_misconceptions: Steel is always stronger than any synthetic material.
ai_context.hint: What property would you most need if your life depended on a rope?

question_text.en: Plastics which when moulded once, cannot be softened by heating are called:
question_text.hi: ऐसे प्लास्टिक (Plastics) जिन्हें एक बार ढालने के बाद गर्म करके नरम नहीं किया जा सकता, क्या कहलाते हैं?

explanation: Thermosetting plastics like Bakelite and Melamine undergo a chemical change during moulding and cannot be remelted.
distractor_rationale: Thermoplastics can be repeatedly softened by heating. Polythene and PVC are examples of thermoplastics.

ai_context.learning_goal: Differentiate between thermoplastics and thermosetting plastics.
common_misconceptions: All plastics can be recycled by melting them.
ai_context.hint: The word 'setting' implies it is permanently set in its shape.

question_text.en: If a polymer is like a necklace, what do the individual beads represent?
question_text.hi: यदि कोई बहुलक (polymer) एक हार की तरह है, तो उसमें मौजूद अलग-अलग मोती क्या दर्शाते हैं?

explanation: A polymer is a large molecule made of many smaller repeating units. These individual repeating units are called monomers.
distractor_rationale: Plastics and synthetic fibres are examples of polymers, not the individual units. Atoms make up the monomers, but the functional repeating unit is the monomer.

ai_context.learning_goal: Understand the structural relationship between monomers and polymers.
common_misconceptions: A polymer is a single giant atom rather than a chain of molecules.
ai_context.hint: What is the term for the 'single unit' that repeats to form a 'many-unit' polymer? Think of the prefixes mono- and poly-.

question_text.en: Which of the following actions best follows the '4R Principle' for managing plastic waste?
question_text.hi: प्लास्टिक कचरे के प्रबंधन के लिए '4R सिद्धांत' (4R Principle) का सबसे अच्छा पालन कौन सा कार्य करता है?

en: Using a reusable cotton bag for shopping
hi: खरीदारी के लिए सूती थैले (cotton bag) का उपयोग करना
प्लास्टिक की बोतलों को नदियों में फेंकना

answer: Using a reusable cotton bag for shopping
explanation: The 4R principle stands for Reduce, Reuse, Recycle, and Recover. Using a cotton bag 'Reduces' the use of plastic bags.
distractor_rationale: Burning causes air pollution. Burying or throwing in rivers causes soil and water pollution because plastic is non-biodegradable.

ai_context.learning_goal: Apply the principles of environmental conservation regarding plastics.
common_misconceptions: Burning plastic safely gets rid of it (it actually releases toxic fumes).
ai_context.hint: Think about ways to prevent new plastic from becoming waste in the first place.
